about_the_game:
Conqueror Of The Galaxy is a fast-paced 2D roguelike space shooter where you must fight, adapt, and conquer. In this free demo, you’ll pilot a customizable spaceship through waves of hostile alien civilizations. Dodge relentless enemy fire, upgrade your ship in real time, and unlock powerful abilities as you survive the chaos of deep space.

This demo offers a focused slice of the full game’s core mechanics, giving you a taste of the progression, intensity, and strategic action that await in the full version.

Key Features in the Demo:

  • Fast and responsive twin-stick space combat

  • Real-time ship upgrades with powerful synergies

  • Multiple enemy types with unique attack patterns

  • Procedurally generated combat scenarios

  • High replayability and escalating difficulty

Master the demo. Conquer the galaxy. And don’t forget to add the full game to your wishlist!
